name: Park Hotel Kenmare
positioning: Historic 1897 hotel on the shores of Kenmare Bay, a short stroll from Kenmare town, with a private art collection and the Landscape spa
best_for: Travelers touring the Ring of Kerry, the Beara Peninsula and the Wild Atlantic Way
Art lovers drawn to a private collection with works by Sean Scully and Andy Warhol
Guests wanting a spa stay with outdoor baths and a lap pool

facts.text: Park Hotel Kenmare is set on the shores of Kenmare Bay in County Kerry, a short stroll from the town of Kenmare.
The hotel has views across Kenmare Bay to the Caha Mountains.
The hotel has welcomed guests since 1897 and was initially constructed as a railway hotel.
Owners Bryan and Tara Meehan arrived at Park Hotel Kenmare in 2023.
All guest rooms and suites were completely renewed, with the work completed in 2026.
Bathrooms have been upgraded with Italian marble and underfoot heating.
The Forever Begin suite is inspired by Brendan Kennelly's poem Begin.
The spa includes a Technogym fitness room and a yoga and Pilates studio with Reformer and Cadillac.
Through the gates of the grounds is Reenagross Park, where guests can dip their toes into the Kenmare River.
The hotel is a base for exploring the Ring of Kerry, the Beara Peninsula and the Wild Atlantic Way.
Landline, the hotel restaurant, takes its name from a Sean Scully piece and celebrates food from where the land meets the sea.
Landline is led by Executive Chef James O'Sullivan and celebrates seasonal produce from Kerry and the surrounding region.

highlights.text: The hotel has a private art collection featuring works by artists including Sean Scully, Andy Warhol and Callum Innes.
Landscape, the hotel's spa, has a lap pool, spa treatments by Susanne Kaufmann and Seabody, outdoor baths, sauna and steam.
The Landscape Suites were designed by Jo Nagasaka of Schemata Architects, Tokyo.
The hotel is situated on 12 acres of gardens, including a herb garden, a croquet lawn and tennis courts.
The hotel hosts daily art tours open to hotel guests as well as visitors.

considerations.text: Children are welcome at the 6.30pm seating in Landline; later seatings are reserved for adult guests.
Kerry Airport is located 40 km from Kenmare.
